title: Just woke from a dream at a mall world location but anyone ever had a feeling like this?
content: So this was an incredibly large and expensive mansion on a beautiful property, 100% in the mall world somewhere, somewhere I think I’ve been. There was a very big party going on with a lot of super “important” people, I didn’t know who most of them were in real life but they were influential. But I couldn’t shake this really dark feeling that a lot of people in this party had a bad backstory, there was something evil and concealed about them, occasionally some of them would chase me and threaten me for fun in this disturbing playful type of way. It felt like everyone was in on some kind of joke but nobody let me in on it. As the dream kept going, things got darker and darker. Eventually I found myself in other locations, like a big city, except the buildings were literally falling over on top of us and explosions everywhere. In the dream though, I wasn’t afraid because I had told myself it was just a highly realistic simulation and so I never died. I just really can’t shake this dark feeling I got from that party and the feeling of concealed evil around me. There was also a very “fun” feeling along with it, like these people knew how to have a really good time but they were not good people. This was also all so vivid and detailed, full story lines, full comprehensive conversations, everything was so real, honestly it felt days long as well. Maybe the wrong sub to post this but I chose this sub because this place absolutely felt like a part of “the mall world”
